payload.name: nowo Immobilien

With in-depth local market knowledge and personalised service, nowo Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Braunschweig real estate market.

Key Benefits

* Faster orientation in Braunschweig and the surrounding region

* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for an apartment in Braunschweig, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, nowo Immobilien offers a modern and transparent way to explore the regional real estate market.
payload.longDescription:

Immobilien 都提供现代、透明的区域房地产探索方式。

payload.name: ExpenseOS
payload.description: 在聊天中提交费用报告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PuraFi turns a conversation into a finished expense report.

Drop receipts into chat as photos, PDFs, or plain descriptions and PuraFi keeps a running list: merchant, date, category, and amount, organized by month or trip. Describe a drive ("office to the Hartford client and back") and PuraFi figures out the actual driving distance and applies the current IRS mileage rate, including the mid-year rate changes your spreadsheet missed.

When you're ready, PuraFi puts everything into a polished PDF report, plus files your finance team can open straight in Excel or QuickBooks. It double-checks every line for the things that get reports bounced back: missing details, forgotten attendees, duplicate charges. Then it sends the report to your approver with a one-click review link. No account or app needed on their end. After you send it, PuraFi tracks where your report stands (pending, approved, or rejected) and counts how many days you've been waiting, so asking "how much am I owed?" always has a real answer.

Use it for:

• Turning receipt photos and PDFs into organized expenses
• Logging business mileage at the current IRS mileage rate
• Building expense reports as PDF, Excel, or QuickBooks-ready files
• Sending expense reports to your manager for one-click approval
• Tracking approval status and how long you've been owed

Try: "File my expenses from this trip" - "Log my drive to the client site and back" - "Make my expense report and submit it to my manager" - "How much am I owed?"

From a pocketful of receipts to a submitted, tracked expense report, without ever leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription:
PuraFi将对话转化为完整的费用报告。

将收据上传至聊天窗口（支持照片、PDF或文字描述），PuraFi会自动生成包含商家、日期、分类和金额的清单，并按月份或行程进行归档。
描述一段行程（"从办公室到哈特福德客户的往返行程"），PuraFi会自动计算实际行驶里程，并应用当前美国国税局的里程费率，包含你电子表格中遗漏的年中税率调整。

准备就绪后，PuraFi会生成精修版PDF报告，并附上财务团队可直接在Excel或QuickBooks中打开的文件。
它会逐一核对每项内容，避免因信息缺失、未记录参与者或重复收费导致报告被退回。
随后通过一键审批链接将报告发送给审批人。
审批方无需注册账户或安装应用。
报告提交后，PuraFi会追踪报告状态（待审批/已批准/已驳回）并统计等待天数，让你随时准确了解"我应得多少报销"。

适用场景：

• 将收据照片和PDF转化为结构化费用记录
• 按当前美国国税局里程费率记录商务出行里程
• 创建可直接用于PDF、Excel或QuickBooks的费用报告
• 一键发送费用报告给主管审批
• 跟踪审批状态及报销等待时长

尝试输入："提交这次旅行的费用" - "记录去客户现场的行程及返程" - "生成费用报告并提交给主管" - "我应得多少报销"

从收集收据到完成提交，整个费用报告流程均可在聊天界面内完成。

payload.name: Furgonetka

Użytkownik może wyświetlić listę przesyłek zamówionych lub nadanych, listę przesyłek śledzonych i monitorowanych, szczegóły konkretnej paczki oraz listę dostępnych przewoźników. payload.name: Quilia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Quilia lets law firm users work with their private Quilia case data from ChatGPT. Users can review setup status and firm settings, manage team members, locations, branding, FAQs, case types, audiences, automations, request templates, cases, appointments, messages, requests, documents, notes, contacts, employment records, and Quilia help content using the same access they have in Quilia.
payload.longDescription: Quilia 让律师事务所用户能够通过 ChatGPT 处理自己在 Quilia 中的私有案件数据。用户可查看设置状态和律所设置，管理团队成员、地点、品牌、常见问题、案件类型、受众、自动化、请求模板、案件、预约、消息、请求、文件、备注、联系人、就业记录及 Quilia 帮助内容；使用的访问权限与其在 Quilia 中相同。

payload.name: Brava
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brava connects a business's loyalty-program data to ChatGPT. It can explain visits and recorded revenue, compare locations and busy periods, identify customer cohorts without exposing phone numbers or email addresses, review past announcement performance, and create prefilled announcement drafts that a person must review and send in Brava. payload.longDescription: Brava 将企业忠诚度计划数据连接到 ChatGPT。它可以解释到店次数和记录的收入、比较地点与繁忙时段、在不暴露电话号码或电子邮件地址的情况下识别客户群、复盘过往公告的表现，并创建预填充的公告草稿；草稿必须由人员审核后在 Brava 中发送。如果用户明确请求 Brava 不支持的功能，它可以为 Brava 产品团队记录私密功能请求，但不会执行该操作。

payload.name: Popl
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Popl is your AI assistant (MCP) for event lead capture, helping marketing and revenue teams enrich, analyze, prospect, and report on event data through natural language.

Before an event, Popl can be used in ChatGPT to help you identify target accounts, enrich attendee and exhibitor lists, match prospects against CRM data, and prioritize the right people to meet. After the event, teams can analyze captured leads, surface key insights, measure performance, and generate detailed ROI reports without manually sorting through spreadsheets or dashboards.

Popl for ChatGPT connects your event data with Popl’s AI-native enrichment engine and broader in-person data layer, giving your team a faster, more conversational way to understand every event. Ask questions, uncover opportunities, and turn offline interactions into structured, actionable data that drives follow-up and revenue.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: SEOcrawl AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query your SEOcrawl account from ChatGPT. After you sign in with your SEOcrawl account, ask about the websites connected to it: Google Search Console performance (clicks, impressions, CTR and average position), the keywords and pages that gained or lost the most between two periods, Google Analytics 4 traffic including visits referred by AI assistants, Google Discover, index coverage and crawl issues, and AI Tracker results that show whether your brand is mentioned or cited in AI answers. You can also work with your SEOcrawl task board: create and update tasks and add comments, tags, annotations and saved views. Actions that change data only affect your own SEOcrawl account. payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT查询您的SEOcrawl账户。登录您的SEOcrawl账户后，可查询与之关联的网站信息：Google搜索控制台表现（点击量、展示量、点击率和平均位置），两个时段内增减最多的关键词和页面，Google Analytics 4流量数据（包含AI助手推荐访问量、Google发现频道流量、索引覆盖率和爬取问题），以及AI追踪结果（显示您的品牌是否在AI回答中被提及或引用）。您还可以使用SEOcrawl任务看板：创建和更新任务并添加评论、标签、注释和保存视图。更改数据的操作仅影响您的个人SEOcrawl账户。需要至少连接一个网站的SEOcrawl账户。

payload.name: LegisGraph
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: We provide a graph-powered infrastructure for programmatic access to an interconnected legal corpus of EU, Italian and Regional legislation and jurisprudence with precise temporal versioning. We empower agents integrating advanced semantic search, linguistic analytics, and real-time legislative monitoring into high-precision legal-tech and research applications.
payload.longDescription: 我们提供由图谱驱动的基础设施，以编程方式访问相互关联的欧盟、意大利和地区立法及判例语料库，并进行精确的时间版本管理。我们帮助智能体将高级语义搜索、语言分析和实时立法监测集成到高精度的法律科技与研究应用中。

payload.name: Gateway Tariff Calculator
payload.description: 美国进口关税与 HTS 编码
payload.summaryOriginal: US import duty and HTS codes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calculate what your imports actually cost before you commit. Enter an HTS code and country of origin and get the duty owed, including every trade action that stacks on top of the base rate: Section 301, Section 232, Section 338, safeguards, AD/CVD and the rest, plus government fees and the landed total. You can also look up HTS classifications for a product, and see what changed in US trade policy and what takes effect next, each with its source. Figures come from the live US Harmonized Tariff Schedule and published trade actions, cited so you can check them. They are planning estimates, not customs rulings. Built and maintained by Gateway Lines, an FMC-licensed NVOCC and ocean freight forwarder, using the same tariff engine that prices our own shipments.
payload.longDescription: 在确定进口前，先计算实际成本。输入 HTS 编码和原产国，即可了解应缴关税，包括叠加在基础税率之上的所有贸易措施：Section 301、Section 232、Section 338、保障措施、反倾销税/反补贴税以及其他费用；此外还会计算政府收费和完税总成本。你也可以查询产品的 HTS 归类，查看美国贸易政策的变化以及即将生效的措施，每项内容均附来源。数据来自实时的美国协调关税表及已公布的贸易措施，并附有引用供你核查。这些是用于规划的估算值，并非海关裁定。由 Gateway Lines（持有 FMC 许可的无船承运人和海运货运代理）开发和维护，使用的关税引擎与其为自有货运报价的引擎相同。

payload.name: growthroles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: growthroles tracks every open marketing and growth role across the companies that publish them, rechecked every night so a closed job is removed rather than wasted on you. It adds what no single job board has: employer-stated pay on thousands of roles, salary benchmarks measured across the whole market with sample sizes and dates, and a written read on each role. Ask in plain words, get roles ranked against your own CV, and track what you applied to.
payload.longDescription: growthroles 跟踪所有发布招聘信息公司的开放营销和增长职位，每晚重新检查，已关闭的职位会被移除。它提供招聘网站没有的内容：数千个职位中由雇主说明的薪酬、按整个市场测算并标注样本量和日期的薪资基准，以及每个职位的文字解读。用日常语言提问，让职位按你的简历排序，并跟踪已申请职位。

payload.name: ecoExperten Energieausweis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.
payload.longDescription:
ecoExperten 连接器将德国能源性能证书服务带入 AI 聊天。出租或出售住宅物业依法需要能源性能证书——使用此应用即可在对话中完成整个订购流程：

1. 咨询：应用会说明适合哪种证书类型，以及需要提供哪些信息（建筑数据和连续三年的年度供暖账单）。
2. 检查：提交订单前，系统会依据《建筑能源法》（GEG）的法律规则免费验证所有信息，例如能耗数据的 18 个月有效期限、《建筑能源法》第 80 条第 3 款规定的需求证书要求，以及空置率限值；此时不会触发订单。
3. 订购：明确同意条款与条件并确认需付费订单后，应用会创建待确认订单，并向所提供的电子邮箱地址发送确认链接。只有点击此链接后，订单才具有约束力；未确认订单会在 48 小时后自动失效。可采用发票付款，聊天中不会处理支付。防重复订单保护可避免意外重复购买。
4. 跟踪：可通过订单号和下单时提供的电子邮箱地址查询处理状态；回复仅包含处理状态，不包含个人或建筑数据。

证书由 CO5 Ingenieurbüro für nachhaltiges Bauen（可注册工程顾问事务所，PartG mbB，柏林）的注册能源顾问签发。每份证书都会获得官方 DIBt 注册编号，通常在 1–2 个工作日内通过电子邮件以 PDF 形式送达。价格：消费型证书含税 59 欧元；需求型证书（119 欧元）可通过网页表单申请。

payload.name: EZFlow Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EZFlow Pro connects your contracting business to ChatGPT. Ask about your customers, jobs, schedule, and money — outstanding invoices, overdue balances, win rates — and create estimates and invoices as drafts. Every document created in chat stays a draft until you review and send it from EZFlow Pro, so nothing reaches a customer without your sign-off. New here? Try the built-in demo workspace — no account needed.
payload.longDescription: EZFlow Pro 连接承包商业务，可查询客户、工作、日程和欠款，并创建报价和发票草稿；聊天中创建的文件在你于 EZFlow Pro 审核发送前不会发给客户。可使用无需账户的演示工作区。

payload.name: UGC VZ
payload.description: 寻找真实 UGC 创作者（DACH）

Brands search the directory by free-text query, city, topics, or verification level, inspect individual creator profiles, and deliberately request contact. UGC VZ then delivers the creators' contact details to the brand by e-mail; the directory takes no commission. Typical workflow: search creators, review a profile, trigger an outreach request, and poll its delivery status. Creator search and profile data never expose private contact details inside ChatGPT.

payload.longDescription: 连接 Lofty CRM，以管理潜在客户、交易和沟通记录。你可以要求查找或更新潜在客户、查看交易状态，或调取某联系人的近期电话、短信和邮件，无需离开聊天。

payload.name: HomePins
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 6,800+ RERA-verified new launch apartments in Bangalore. Get live pricing, possession timelines, builder track records, booking velocity, and commute distances to IT hubs. Book site visits or request callbacks directly.
payload.longDescription: 搜索班加罗尔 6,800+ 套经 RERA 核实的新楼盘公寓。获取实时价格、交房时间表、开发商历史记录、预订速度以及前往 IT 中心的通勤距离。可直接预约实地看房或申请回电。

payload.name: Trooth Network
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trooth is the trust network for the software economy. This connector lets anyone in a ChatGPT conversation look up a company's current, witnessed record on Trooth across nine categories, from identity and security to privacy, AI practices, and history, each with its source and the date it was last read. Read a company before you rely on it, compare two vendors on the same categories before you buy, take a live neutral read of a domain's public security surface, verify a signed Trust Ledger Token, or ask how Trooth works. A company can also look up its own record to see what buyers see. Every answer names its source and date, witnessed evidence is labeled apart from what a company declares, and anything not settled comes back marked unknown rather than guessed. It is read-only and returns only public data, with no account and no login.
payload.longDescription: Trooth 是面向软件经济的信任网络。这个连接器让 ChatGPT 对话中的任何人都能查询 Trooth 上一家公司当前经过见证的记录，覆盖 9 个类别，从身份和安全到隐私、AI 实践及历史；每项记录都会列明来源和最近读取日期。在依赖一家公司前先查看其记录；购买前按相同类别比较两家供应商；实时、中立地查看某个域名的公开安全状况；验证已签名的 Trust Ledger Token；或询问 Trooth 的工作方式。公司也可以查询自己的记录，了解买家所看到的内容。每条答复都会注明来源和日期；经过见证的证据会与公司自行声明的内容分开标注；任何尚未确定的事项都会标记为未知，而不会靠猜测补全。该工具为只读模式，只返回公开数据，无需账户或登录。

payload.name: AgencyAnalytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgencyAnalytics is the only reporting and insights platform built for marketing agencies — and now it works directly inside ChatGPT. Connect every client's marketing channels into one place across SEO, PPC, social media, email, call tracking, ecommerce, and more, with 85+ integrations. Then query any of it, instantly, without leaving your AI workflow.

Ask about a client's Google Ads performance before a call, pull a cross-channel summary to spot what's working, or compare results across multiple clients in a single prompt. No login, no export, no digging through dashboards. Data comes straight from your connected integrations, so it's always accurate and up to date.

Your existing AgencyAnalytics permissions carry over automatically, so every team member only sees the clients they're supposed to. Setup takes under 60 seconds with no installation required.
payload.longDescription:
AgencyAnalytics 是唯一专为营销代理机构打造的报告与洞察平台——如今可直接在 ChatGPT 中使用。通过85+种集成，将每位客户的SEO、PPC、社交媒体、电子邮件、通话跟踪、电商等营销渠道连接到同一个地方。随后无需离开AI工作流程，即可即时查询其中任何内容。

在通话前询问客户的 Google Ads 表现，获取跨渠道摘要来了解哪些做法有效，或在一个提示中比较多位客户的结果。无需登录、导出或翻查仪表盘。数据直接来自已连接的集成，因此始终准确且保持最新。

现有的 AgencyAnalytics 权限会自动沿用，每位团队成员只能看到其获准查看的客户。设置耗时不到60秒，无需安装。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 101 connects ChatGPT to your workspace for financial analysis and project operations. Analyze company financial health using balances, income, expenses, transactions, bills, contractor settlements, and cost categories. Review and manage settlements and linked transfers. Search projects, tasks, comments, team members, estimates, price lists, and Wiki pages. Create and edit financial events, transfers, estimates, tasks, comments, and Wiki content.
payload.longDescription: 101 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的工作区，开展财务分析和项目运营。利用余额、收入、支出、交易、账单、承包商结算和成本类别分析公司财务健康状况。查看和管理结算及关联转账。搜索项目、任务、评论、团队成员、估算、价目表和 Wiki 页面。创建和编辑财务事件、转账、估算、任务、评论和 Wiki 内容。

payload.name: Sellergoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de
payload.longDescription:
Sellergoo 是面向线上卖家的利润和运营分析服务。连接你当前用于销售的店铺、交易平台、支付和会计账户后，Sellergoo 会汇总订单、费用、退款、商品成本、广告支出和间接费用，计算你的实际收入，并按渠道、商品和订单分别呈现。

此插件让你可以用自然语言询问这些数据，无需导出电子表格。你可以询问上个月扣除费用后的实际收益、哪些 SKU 利润空间很薄、交易平台实际向银行账户打了多少钱，或哪些商品最先缺货。

只读
此插件只能查看数据，不能在 Sellergoo 或任何已连接的店铺或交易平台中下单、取消、退款、重新定价或更改任何内容。它提供的每项工具都为只读，你授予的访问权限不包含写入权限。它只会读取本属于你的数据，以回答你提出的问题。

可回答的问题
• 利润 — 某个时间段内的销售额、销量、退款、费用、商品成本、广告支出、间接费用、毛利和净利润、利润率及 ROI；可合计查看，也可按渠道查看。
• 损益 — 最多可查看最近 12 个月的逐月损益表，可包括全部渠道或单个渠道。
• 订单 — 任意日期范围内的订单，支持分页，并显示每笔订单的销售额和交易平台费用。
• 商品 — 某段时间内按 SKU 统计的销售额、销量、利润率和利润，并按销售额排序。
• 结算款 — 交易平台和支付服务商实际支付的结算款，按明细类型汇总金额。
• 库存 — 每个 SKU 的现有库存、30 天售罄率和可售天数，每次查看一个销售渠道。
• 警报 — 缺货、库存偏低、利润率过薄、失去 Buy Box、价格变动和负面评价。
• 渠道 — 已连接的店铺，以及各店铺上次同步时间。

所需条件
需要 Sellergoo 账户（sellergoo.com）。登录并批准连接一次即可，无需手动复制或粘贴任何内容。答案的完整程度取决于你连接的账户；新账户会返回空数据，而非报错。你也可以随时询问当前读取的是哪个账户。

Sellergoo 支持 Amazon、eBay、OTTO、Kaufland、Shopify、WooCommerce、Etsy 和 Stripe，另支持 QuickBooks 会计服务以及 UPS 和 FedEx 运输服务。Walmart 计划支持，但目前尚不可用。金额以欧元报告。

独立产品
Sellergoo 由 Wolfsohn Handel（Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn，德国 Einzelunternehmen）开发。它与 Amazon、eBay、OTTO、Kaufland、Shopify、WooCommerce、Etsy、Stripe、Intuit、UPS 或 FedEx 均无关联，也未获其认可、赞助或认证。这些名称仅用于说明 Sellergoo 可以为你读取哪些自有账户。

你的数据
返回的数据属于商业数据：总额、费用、SKU、库存和结算款。订单记录不包含买家姓名、地址、电子邮件地址或付款详情。此处返回的内容不会用于训练任何模型。你可以随时在 Sellergoo 的 Settings → API keys 中断开连接；断开后立即停止工作，没有宽限期。

文档：https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
隐私：https://sellergoo.com/privacy · 条款：https://sellergoo.com/terms
支持：info@wolfsohn.de

payload.name: VerticalResponse
payload.description: 联系人、列表与电子邮件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VerticalResponse helps users search contacts, inspect contact details, manage contact lists, sample random contacts, export sanitized contact data, create and update draft email campaigns, send test emails, launch or schedule campaigns with explicit confirmation, and review email campaign performance from ChatGPT. The app supports a deterministic OAuth review demo account, uses explicit validated inputs for contact and campaign fields, never exposes credentials or raw API responses, and does not implement delete tools for campaigns, contacts, or lists.
payload.longDescription: VerticalResponse 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中搜索联系人、查看联系人详情、管理联系人列表、抽样随机联系人、导出经过清理的联系人数据、创建和更新电子邮件营销活动草稿、发送测试邮件、经明确确认后启动或安排营销活动，以及查看邮件营销活动表现。该应用支持确定性的 OAuth 审核演示账户；联系人和营销活动字段均使用明确且经过验证的输入；绝不暴露凭据或原始 API 响应；并且不提供删除营销活动、联系人或列表的工具。

payload.name: Pace
payload.description: 掌握每笔交易的实时背景
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pace is the context layer for your sales pipeline. It pre-computes deal intelligence from your CRM, emails, and call recordings, then serves it to your AI assistant as live, structured context on every deal. Ask what's really going on with an account, get AI risk and forecast assessments backed by evidence, catch deals that have gone quiet, and know precisely where your team is going to land. No more digging through Salesforce or HubSpot, no more guessing.
payload.longDescription: Pace 是销售管道的上下文层。它会从 CRM、电子邮件和通话录音中预先计算交易情报，然后将每笔交易的实时结构化上下文提供给 AI 助手。你可以询问某个客户账户的真实情况，获取有证据支持的 AI 风险和预测评估，发现陷入停滞的交易，并准确了解团队最终业绩。无需再翻查 Salesforce 或 HubSpot，也不必猜测。

payload.name: Relay Tow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Relay Tow gives towing providers a conversational view of their operations. Look up active dispatches, check which drivers are on call, review driver performance, pull invoices and impound records, calculate charges against your rate cards, and generate reports — without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: Relay Tow 以对话方式展示拖车服务商的运营情况。无需离开聊天即可查询当前派单、查看哪些司机值班、审查司机绩效、调取发票和扣押记录、按费率卡计算费用并生成报告。

payload.name: LinkupAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Automate your outreach across B2B channels, right from your GPT. Find prospects, research people and companies, personalize and send your messages, send connection requests, and read your inbox and replies, all from your own connected accounts.
payload.longDescription: 直接从你的 GPT 自动开展跨 B2B 渠道的外联。通过自己已连接的账户寻找潜在客户、研究个人和公司、个性化并发送消息、发送连接请求，以及阅读收件箱和回复。

payload.name: Yolando
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yolando spots emerging trends, connects the dots, and moves before the market – or your competitors – see it coming.

Connect your Yolando workspace to ask, in plain language, how ChatGPT and other AI assistants describe your business, where you're cited and where you're not, and how your visibility compares to your competitors'. Pull citation and reputation trends, track competitor movements, and get a prioritized list of what to create, optimize, or fix — all from your own workspace data, right inside the conversation.

Requires a Yolando account.
payload.longDescription:
Yolando 能发现新兴趋势、串联线索，并在市场或竞争对手察觉之前采取行动。

连接 Yolando 工作区后，你可以用日常语言询问 ChatGPT 和其他 AI 助手如何描述你的业务、在哪些地方引用或未引用你，以及你的可见度与竞争对手相比如何。查看引用和声誉趋势、跟踪竞争对手动向，并获取按优先级排列的待创建、优化或修复事项——所有内容都来自你自己的工作区数据，直接呈现在对话中。

需要 Yolando 账户。

payload.name: Famulor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Famulor lets users inspect existing AI assistant configurations, saved versions, available models, languages, voices, and past conversation history in their authenticated workspace. This read-only directory profile cannot create or change assistants, start calls, send messages, launch campaigns, purchase phone numbers, or open billing flows.
payload.longDescription: Famulor 可让用户在已认证的工作区中查看现有 AI 助手配置、保存的版本、可用模型、语言、声音和过往对话记录。此只读目录档案无法创建或更改助手、发起通话、发送消息、启动活动、购买电话号码或打开账单流程。

payload.name: Magnus
payload.description: 面向应用发布商的分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.
payload.longDescription:
Magnus 是面向移动和 Web 应用发布商的分析平台。它将广告网络营销支出、订阅和应用内收入、广告网络变现、支付服务商结果以及第一方产品分析事件汇总到一个地方，让发布商可以询问某个活动、应用或实验的真实表现。

该应用通过 MCP 以只读方式提供数据。三个工具用于回答问题：marketing_timeline_report 提供获客和变现表现（安装量、支出、收入、ROMI、预测）；finances_risk_report 和 finances_risk_approval_rates 提供支付风险信息（批准率、退款、欺诈警报、争议、拒付）。另一组工具根据发布商自己的 SDK 事件回答产品分析问题：事件数量、漏斗、留存、用户属性分群和 A/B 实验配置。其他工具都是查找辅助工具，用于为上述工具提供真实 ID、筛选值和指标定义，因为应用 ID、事件名称和指标含义因账户而异，无法猜测。

访问权限限定在已登录用户作为活跃成员所属的公司内，并且每次调用都会重新检查成员资格，因此模型永远无法访问其他租户的数据。应用请求的 OAuth 范围 mcp:analytics.read 仅授予读取权限：服务器中没有任何工具可以创建、更新或删除内容。

payload.name: Nowlun Tracking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nowlun turns a Bill of Lading into a live shipment view. Upload the document, or just paste a BL, booking, or container number, and get the current status back in the chat.

Beyond tracking identifiers, it reads the full contents of the BL — shipper and consignee, notify party, cargo description, container numbers and sizes, ports of loading and discharge, vessel and voyage, and commercial terms. So instead of retyping details from a PDF into a portal, you can ask questions about the document directly.

Once the shipment is identified, you get:

Current status and last known milestone
Vessel, voyage, and carrier details
ETD and ETA, with schedule changes when the carrier updates them
Container-level breakdown for multi-container shipments
An interactive map showing the route and where the vessel is now

Useful for freight forwarders, importers and exporters, and anyone who handles shipping documents and wants an answer without logging into three carrier websites.

Nowlun is a digital freight forwarding platform covering sea freight, air cargo, customs clearance, and inland trucking. No account is required to track a shipment.
payload.longDescription:
Nowlun 可将提单转换为实时货运视图。上传文件，或直接粘贴 BL、订舱或集装箱编号，即可在聊天中获取当前状态。

除了追踪标识符，它还会读取 BL 的完整内容——发货人和收货人、通知方、货物描述、集装箱编号及尺寸、装货港和卸货港、船舶与航次，以及商业条款。因此，你无需再把 PDF 中的信息手动录入门户网站，可以直接询问文件内容。

识别货物后，你可以查看：

当前状态和最近已知节点
船舶、航次和承运人详情
ETD 和 ETA，以及承运人更新后的日程变更
多集装箱货运的逐箱明细
显示航线及船舶当前位置的交互式地图

适用于货运代理、进口商、出口商，以及任何需要处理运输文件、希望无需登录三个承运人网站就能获取答案的人。

Nowlun 是一家数字货运代理平台，涵盖海运、空运、清关和内陆卡车运输。追踪货运无需账户。

payload.name: Alvamitra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alvamitra membantu pengguna mencari produk CCTV dan perangkat keamanan, melihat stok, spesifikasi, dan rekomendasi produk berdasarkan kebutuhan. Pengguna juga dapat membuka halaman produk atau menghubungi Alvamitra untuk melakukan pemesanan perangkat fisik.
payload.longDescription: Alvamitra 帮助用户查找 CCTV 产品和安防设备，查看库存、规格以及基于需求的产品推荐。用户还可以打开产品页面或联系 Alvamitra，订购实体设备。

payload.name: SourceFlag
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SourceFlag helps users scan direct public RFP PDF URLs from ChatGPT and receive a bounded readiness preview with deadline signals, mandatory event signals, addenda and Q&A risk, missing-document warnings, bid/no-bid blockers, and sample compliance-matrix rows.
payload.longDescription: SourceFlag 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 扫描直接公开的 RFP PDF URL，并获得范围明确的准备情况预览，其中包括截止日期提示、强制性活动提示、补遗和问答风险、缺失文件警告、投标/不投标阻碍因素，以及合规矩阵示例行。

payload.name: Meistron
payload.description: 通过人工智能处理订单与发票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Meistron ist die Betriebssoftware für Handwerksbetriebe. Über den KI-Zugang verbindet ein Betrieb ChatGPT mit seinen Daten: Aufträge und Termine, Kunden, Rechnungen und Angebote, Material und Bestand, Arbeitszeiten, Lieferanten, Wartungsverträge und ausgewählte Einstellungen lassen sich abfragen und pflegen. Neu in dieser Version: eine Tagesübersicht in einem Aufruf, die Kundensuche mit Kundennummer, Wartungsverträge, eine Versandvorschau vor jeder Rechnungs-E-Mail und – nur nach eigener Freigabe im Bereich „Dokumente“ – das Lesen von Beleg-, Nachweis- und Bestandslisten-PDFs. Ausgestellte Belege kommen dabei ausschließlich als unverändertes Original.

Die Rechte sind in zehn Bereichen einzeln auf aus, lesen oder schreiben einstellbar. Alles, was nach außen wirkt (E-Mail an Kunden, Push-Meldung an Mitarbeiter), hat einen eigenen Schalter und ist ab Werk aus. Der Zugang verschickt keine Briefe, gibt keine Bankverbindung oder Zahlungsanweisung aus und löscht keine Datensätze. Eine Rechnung geht im Normalfall erst nach einer Vorschau und einer ausdrücklichen Bestätigung hinaus; ohne Rückfrage nur, wenn der Inhaber für genau diesen Zugang die Vollautonomie einschaltet.

33 Werkzeuge und sieben fertige Abläufe, etwa Arbeitstag vorbereiten, offene Posten durchgehen oder den Monat vor dem Steuerberater prüfen. Anmeldung über OAuth 2.1 mit PKCE; jede Verbindung bestätigt der Betrieb auf einer Zustimmungsseite.
payload.longDescription:
Meistron是面向手工业企业的运营软件。通过人工智能访问功能，企业可将ChatGPT与自身数据连接：订单与时间安排、客户信息、发票与报价单、材料与库存、工作时间、供应商、维护合同及部分设置均可查询和维护。
本次版本新增功能包括：一次操作即可查看每日概览、通过客户编号进行客户搜索、发送发票前的运输预览功能，以及在「文档」区域经手动授权后可阅读凭证、证明及库存清单的PDF文件。
开具的凭证仅以原始未修改版本呈现。

权限可分别在十个功能区域中单独设置为只读或可写模式。
所有对外显示内容（如发送给客户的邮件、发送给员工的推送消息）均有独立开关，默认已开启。
该访问权限不会发送信件、泄露银行信息或支付指令，也不会删除数据记录。
正常情况下，发票需经过预览和明确确认后才会发出；仅当账户持有者为该访问权限单独开启完全自主模式时，可无需确认直接发送。

包含33个工具和7个预设流程，例如准备工作日、处理未结事项或在税务顾问面前审查月份数据。
通过OAuth 2.1+PKCE进行注册；每次连接都需要企业通过同意页面进行确认。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The plugin enables Motive dealer customers to manage their website directly inside of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 该插件使Motive经销商客户能够直接在ChatGPT中管理其网站。

payload.name: Scoutee
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Scoutee searches public procurement notices published by official journals and buyer platforms across Europe and North America, refreshed every morning. Ask for tenders by keywords, countries and estimated value, compare buyers and deadlines, then open one notice to read its procedure, CPV codes and an excerpt. Every result links to the notice's public page on scoutee.org; the full description, the buyer's platform, the tender documents, email alerts and the AI analysis come with a free Scoutee account.
payload.longDescription: Scoutee 搜索欧洲和北美官方公报及采购方平台发布的公共采购公告，每天早晨更新。按关键词、国家和预估金额查找招标，比较采购方和截止日期，然后打开公告查看流程、CPV 代码和摘要。每条结果都链接到 scoutee.org 上的公告公开页面；完整说明、采购方平台、招标文件、电子邮件提醒和 AI 分析需使用免费的 Scoutee 账户。

payload.name: BetterMenu
payload.description: 根据配方生成 FDA 标签
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BetterMenu keeps recipe formulation, nutrition analysis and FDA labeling in one versioned system, so compliance stops being a separate project at the end of development.

Search standard and branded ingredients, resolve kitchen measures to gram weights, and calculate per-serving and per-container nutrition against the FDA reference values in 21 CFR 101. Add custom ingredients with your own nutrition data, set serving sizes, and export the Nutrition Facts label.

Every recipe is versioned: reformulate freely, then see which ingredient change moved which nutrient, and which version any given label came from. Values carry their source, so you can answer where a number came from without reconstructing it.

For food manufacturers, co-packers, and R&D and regulatory teams working on packaged food sold in the United States.
payload.longDescription:
BetterMenu 将配方设计、营养分析和 FDA 标签管理集中在一个有版本记录的系统中，让合规工作不再成为开发末期的独立项目。

搜索标准及品牌食材，将厨房计量单位转换为克重，并依据 21 CFR 101 中的 FDA 参考值计算每份和每容器的营养成分。使用自己的营养数据添加自定义食材，设置份量，并导出营养成分标签。

每个配方都有版本记录：自由调整配方，然后查看哪项食材变动改变了哪种营养素，以及每张标签来自哪个版本。数值附带来源，让你无需重新推算就能说明数字出处。

适合食品制造商、代工包装商，以及从事美国市场包装食品工作的研发和法规团队。

payload.name: Semji
payload.description: 规划并评估 SEO 内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Semji is a content platform for marketing teams. This app gives access to the Semji workspaces a user already belongs to, so an editorial pipeline can be driven in conversation: browse the content pipeline with the same filters as the app, add drafts to the planning in bulk from titles and focus keywords, run SEO and GEO keyword analyses, and read the resulting Content Score with typed recommendations per surface (Google Search, Google AI Overview, ChatGPT). Optional AI drafting is available and always lands in a review state first, so nothing is written to a draft without an explicit confirmation. Access follows the user's own Semji permissions: they reach only the workspaces their account already has, with the role they already hold there, and every call is authorised server-side against the organization their token belongs to.
payload.longDescription: Semji 是面向营销团队的内容平台。此应用可访问用户已加入的 Semji 工作区，让用户通过对话管理编辑流程：使用与应用相同的筛选条件浏览内容流程；根据标题和重点关键词批量将草稿添加到规划中；运行 SEO 和 GEO 关键词分析；并查看 Content Score 及针对各个平台（Google Search、Google AI Overview、ChatGPT）的分类建议。可选的 AI 起草功能始终先将内容置于待审核状态，因此未经明确确认不会写入草稿。访问权限遵循用户在 Semji 中已有的权限：用户只能访问其账户原本有权进入的工作区，并保留在那里已有的角色；每次调用都会在服务器端根据其令牌所属组织进行授权。

payload.name: PaidSync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PaidSync lets ChatGPT operate your own paid media accounts across 13 platforms from one connection: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, Microsoft, and ChatGPT Ads, plus Google Analytics (GA4), Gootle Tag Manager (GTM), Search Console, and Merchant Center. Audit accounts, compare performance across platforms, find wasted spend, draft budget and bid changes, build audiences, and set up conversion tracking. PaidSync changes campaign settings only. It never moves money or processes payments. Every write is drafted for your review, and nothing is applied until you confirm.
payload.longDescription: PaidSync通过单一连接让您在13个平台上操作自己的付费媒体账户：Google Ads、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn、Snapchat、Reddit、Pinterest、Microsoft以及ChatGPT Ads，同时支持Google Analytics（GA4）、Google Tag Manager（GTM）、Search Console和Merchant Center。审计账户，跨平台比较表现，发现浪费支出，撰写预算和出价修改方案，构建受众群体，并设置转化跟踪。PaidSync仅修改广告设置，从不转移资金或处理支付。所有修改都会先为您草拟，未经确认不会执行。

payload.name: Website Auditor
payload.description: 审查网站与 AI 可见度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: See whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named in the answers, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing weekly monitoring. The built-in sample report needs no API key and no setup, so you can see exactly what a full report looks like before connecting an account.
payload.longDescription: 了解 AI 助手是否真的会推荐你的企业。Website Auditor 会向 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 提出真实客户可能会问的问题，报告回答中提到的企业，并进行 SEO、安全标头、失效链接和性能检查；提供整体 AI 可见度评分（0–100）、各引擎细分、竞争对手比较和持续的每周监测。内置示例报告无需 API 密钥或设置，让你在连接账户前就能准确了解完整报告的样子。

payload.name: Teamspective
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Teamspective is a Leadership Enablement Platform that helps leaders understand their teams through engagement surveys, feedback, and collaboration insights. This app enables ChatGPT to access your Teamspective workspace data, providing personalized insights about:

- Your identity & context: Role, teams, direct reports, and data access permissions
- Engagement results: Survey scores, KPIs (engagement, wellbeing, leadership, DEIB), themes, trends, and AI-interpreted insights with benchmarks
- Feedback summaries: Growth feedback, praise, and performance evaluations you've received or given to direct reports
- Survey comments: Qualitative insights from open-text responses with sentiment analysis

Perfect for preparing 1:1s, understanding team sentiment, identifying areas needing attention, and getting actionable leadership guidance.
payload.longDescription:
Teamspective 是一个领导力赋能平台，帮助领导者通过敬业度调查、反馈和协作洞察了解团队。此应用可让 ChatGPT 访问你的 Teamspective 工作区数据，并针对以下内容提供个性化洞察：

- 你的身份与背景：角色、团队、直接下属及数据访问权限
- 敬业度结果：调查得分、KPI（敬业度、幸福感、领导力、DEIB）、主题、趋势，以及结合基准数据的 AI 解读洞察
- 反馈摘要：你收到的成长反馈与赞扬，以及你给直接下属的绩效评价
- 调查评论：带有情绪分析的开放文本定性洞察

适合用于准备 1:1 沟通、了解团队情绪、发现需要关注的领域，并获得可执行的领导建议。

payload.name: Ad Superpowers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ad Superpowers connects ChatGPT to the advertising and analytics accounts a marketer already runs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.

Read workflows: pull campaign results across platforms and compare them, find which creatives are fatiguing, check why a campaign stopped spending, reconcile conversion numbers that differ between a platform and GA4, compare paid keywords against organic Search Console queries, and audit a Tag Manager container before a release.

Write workflows: pause or adjust a campaign that is overspending, fix a wrong landing-page URL on a live ad without losing its social proof, duplicate a winning ad into a new variant, upload creative assets, and build a new ad. Write tools that publish are gated behind an explicit plan-and-confirm step, so the user reads what will change and confirms it before anything is created.

Every account is connected by the customer through OAuth in the Ad Superpowers dashboard. The app only reaches accounts that customer has connected, and tools for platforms they have not connected are not offered at all.
payload.longDescription:
Ad Superpowers 将 ChatGPT 连接到营销人员已在使用的广告及分析账户：Meta Ads、Google Ads、Google Analytics 4、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager、Google Merchant Center、LinkedIn Ads 和 TikTok Ads。

读取流程：获取并比较各平台营销活动结果，查找哪些创意出现疲劳，检查营销活动为何停止花费，核对平台与GA4不一致的转化数字，将付费关键词与自然流量的 Search Console 查询进行比较，并在发布前审计 Tag Manager 容器。

写入流程：暂停或调整超支的营销活动，在保留社交认可信息的同时修复在线广告中错误的落地页URL，将表现优秀的广告复制为新变体，上传创意素材，以及创建新广告。涉及发布的写入工具必须经过明确的规划和确认步骤，让用户先阅读将发生的变更并确认，再创建任何内容。

客户通过 Ad Superpowers 仪表盘中的OAuth连接每个账户。应用仅能访问该客户已连接的账户，未连接平台的工具完全不会提供。

payload.name: LLM Pulse
payload.description: 追踪 AI 品牌曝光度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LLM Pulse helps teams monitor how their brands, competitors, prompts, and sources appear across AI answers. Use it to explore visibility, mentions, citations, sentiment, recommendations, and traffic signals from your LLM Pulse workspace directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: LLM Pulse 帮助团队监测其品牌、竞争对手、提示词和来源在 AI 回答中的呈现情况。你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中通过 LLM Pulse 工作区查看曝光度、提及、引用、情绪倾向、建议和流量信号。

payload.name: Kinevo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kinevo conecta personal trainers à gestão completa do seu negócio direto pelo ChatGPT. Gerencie alunos, crie programas de treino, prescreva exercícios, acompanhe progresso, envie mensagens e monitore receita — tudo por linguagem natural. 27 ferramentas disponíveis para automatizar sua rotina como personal trainer.
payload.longDescription: Kinevo 让私人教练可以直接通过 ChatGPT 全面管理业务。用自然语言管理学员、创建训练计划、开具运动处方、跟踪进度、发送消息并监控收入。提供 27 种工具，帮助自动化私人教练的日常工作。

payload.name: Ausschreibungsagenten.de
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ausschreibungsagenten.de searches current public procurement notices for the German-speaking market and the wider EU. It covers German federal above- and below-threshold notices through service.bund.de and Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf, all 27 EU member states including Germany and Austria through TED, and the United Kingdom through Find a Tender and Contracts Finder. Users can filter by keyword, buyer country, CPV code, deadline window and contract value, open a single notice in full, read a labelled AI summary in German or English, check which portals are connected and how fresh each one is, and see which countries currently hold the most open procedures. Built for contractors, agencies and bid teams in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Every result carries the link to the authoritative original notice, which always prevails over anything shown here.
payload.longDescription: Ausschreibungsagenten.de 搜索德语市场及更广泛欧盟地区的当前公共采购公告。它通过 service.bund.de 和 Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf 覆盖德国联邦高于及低于采购门槛的公告，通过 TED 覆盖包括德国和奥地利在内的全部 27 个欧盟成员国，并通过 Find a Tender 和 Contracts Finder 覆盖英国。用户可按关键词、采购方国家、CPV 代码、截止日期范围和合同金额筛选，打开单条公告全文，阅读明确标注的德语或英语 AI 摘要，查看已连接的门户及各门户的数据新鲜度，并了解哪些国家目前有最多开放中的采购程序。专为德国、奥地利和瑞士的承包商、代理机构和投标团队打造。每项结果都附有权威原始公告链接，原始公告始终优先于这里显示的任何内容。

payload.name: Slipa
payload.description: 将屏幕录制转成演示视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slipa turns a rough screen recording into a finished demo video. It transcribes what you said, rewrites it as a clean script, re-voices it with a narrator in any of twenty-nine languages, and renders the result with your logo, brand colours and captions. The narration language is independent of the recording language, so you can record once and publish in another. Ask for a video and Slipa tells you what it will cost before it spends anything.
payload.longDescription: Slipa 可将粗略的屏幕录制转换为完成度高的演示视频。它会转写你说的话，将其改写为流畅脚本，由旁白以二十九种语言中的任一种重新配音，并为成片添加你的标志、品牌颜色和字幕。旁白语言与录制语言互不依赖，因此你可以录制一次，再用另一种语言发布。请求生成视频时，Slipa 会先告知费用，然后才会产生任何支出。

payload.name: Postify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.
payload.longDescription:
Postify 是面向团队的社交媒体排程工具：通过一个日历管理您发布内容的账户，并在一处管理草稿、排期和发布分析。Postify 插件让 ChatGPT 与您共同管理该日历：列出帖子并打开特定帖子、查看已连接的渠道、起草新帖子、将已排期帖子改到其他时间、在媒体库中搜索已上传的图片、询问建议的发布时间、立即发布帖子或删除帖子。它还可以提取已发布帖子的效果数据，并在您想了解某项功能时搜索 Postify 自有文档。

访问通过 OAuth 2.1 和 PKCE 实现，颁发的令牌绑定到 Postify MCP 端点。您可以在授权页面选择权限范围；未获授权的工具不会注册到会话中，因此助手无法看到它。已连接应用会列在“设置”中，您可在那里撤销连接；每次工具调用都会写入审计日志，您可以在应用中查阅。

两项不可撤销的操作——发布和删除——特意设置了双重门控。首先，组织设置决定 AI 助手是否可以执行这些操作，且只有 Postify 内的人员可以启用该设置；任何 AI 凭证都不具备启用它所需的权限范围。其次，启用后，首次调用会返回确认请求及一个短时有效、绑定到确切参数的令牌；必须在第二次调用中原样回传该令牌，才会执行发布或删除。首次响应是安全机制正常工作的表现，并非错误。

payload.name: Optmyzr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Optmyzr helps advertisers and agencies inspect linked ad-account performance, opportunities, analytics, alerts, and workspace data; find product guidance; create monitoring routines; and prepare or apply reviewable keyword and negative-keyword changes from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Optmyzr 帮助广告主和代理机构查看已关联广告账户的表现、机会、分析数据、提醒和工作区数据；查找产品指导；创建监控例程；并通过 ChatGPT 准备或应用可审核的关键词和否定关键词更改。

payload.name: mydeetz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Share your contact details with businesses on mydeetz. Look up a company to see what information they need, then share your name, email, and other details directly with them without leaving ChatGPT. You can also save your profile so your details are pre-filled when contacting other businesses. An email notification is sent to the business with your shared information.
payload.longDescription:
在mydeetz上向企业分享您的联系信息。
查找目标公司可查看其所需信息，随后可直接在不离开ChatGPT的情况下分享姓名、邮箱及其他详细信息。
您也可以保存资料卡，下次联系其他企业时信息将自动填充。
系统会向企业发送包含您分享信息的邮件通知。

payload.name: Whatalo
payload.description: 管理你的 Whatalo 商店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Whatalo connects ChatGPT to a merchant's store so users can review store information, products, categories, inventory, customers, and orders. It also supports controlled catalog updates, inventory adjustments, product image uploads, and order status changes through the merchant's authorized Whatalo account.
payload.longDescription: Whatalo 将 ChatGPT 连接到商家的商店，让用户查看商店信息、商品、类别、库存、客户和订单。它还支持通过商家授权的 Whatalo 账户，以受控方式更新目录、调整库存、上传商品图片和更改订单状态。

payload.name: Perseuss
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare shipping rate estimates from USPS, UPS, and FedEx before you ship. Simply provide your origin address, destination, and package weight to see estimated costs and delivery times side-by-side.

This app provides informational rate estimates powered by EasyPost, it does not book shipments or process transactions. Once you find the option that works for you, continue directly to the carrier's website to complete your shipment.

Perfect for:
• Comparing prices across carriers
• Estimating delivery times
• Planning shipping costs before committing
payload.longDescription:
寄送前可比较USPS、UPS和FedEx的运费估算。
只需提供您的起始地址、目的地和包裹重量，即可并排查看预估费用和送达时间。

此应用提供的运费估算信息由EasyPost提供，不处理运输预订或交易。
找到适合您的选项后，可直接跳转至承运商官网完成寄送操作。

适用场景：
• 跨承运商比价
• 预估送达时间
• 在下单前规划运费成本

payload.name: Laurel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Laurel is the AI timekeeping and work intelligence platform built for professional services firms. This plugin brings that work into ChatGPT, so knowledge workers can review their day without leaving the conversation. Retrieve the time entries and activities Laurel captured throughout the day, and see where billable time went. Summarize work by client, matter, or application, and spot the gaps between what got done and what's been recorded. Turn that activity into billing narratives, ready for an end-of-day or weekly review. Access stays tied to your Laurel account throughout.
payload.longDescription: Laurel 是面向专业服务公司的 AI 工时记录与工作洞察平台。该插件将工作带入 ChatGPT，让知识工作者无需离开对话即可回顾一天的工作。检索 Laurel 全天记录的工时条目和活动，了解计费工时的去向。按客户、事项或应用汇总工作，并找出已完成工作与记录内容之间的差距。将活动转化为账单说明，方便在日末或每周回顾时使用。访问权限始终与你的 Laurel 账户绑定。

payload.name: Zeck
payload.description: 连接你的 Zeck.app 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This connector will allow Codex or ChatGPT to read information stored in your Zeck companies. It authorizes using your existing Zeck user account to only be able to read information you have permission to view. After connected, it can read a user's companies, the list of Zecks in each company, and the contents of published Zecks. This allows collaboration with Codex or ChatGPT for securely permissioned Zeck materials.
payload.longDescription: 此连接器允许 Codex 或 ChatGPT 读取存储在 Zeck 公司空间中的信息。它使用你现有的 Zeck 用户账号进行授权，且只能读取你有权查看的信息。连接后，可以读取用户所属公司、每家公司中的 Zeck 列表，以及已发布 Zeck 的内容。这样即可与 Codex 或 ChatGPT 协作处理权限受控的 Zeck 材料。

payload.name: Noah
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Noah Predict helps users investigate public signals, assess risk and trends, commission durable research, retrieve evidence-backed results, continue an investigation, and create client-ready research artifacts.
payload.longDescription: Noah Predict 帮助用户调查公开信号、评估风险和趋势、委托持久化研究、获取有证据支持的结果、继续调查，并创建面向客户的研究成果。

payload.name: Asanify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Asanify helps users estimate employment costs, look up employee and attendance information, review pending approval requests, and approve or reject requests through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Asanify帮助用户估算用工成本，查询员工及考勤信息，审查待审批请求，并通过ChatGPT批准或拒绝请求。

payload.name: 4Degrees - KSA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 4Degrees brings your relationship intelligence and deal flow into ChatGPT for teams on our Saudi Arabia region. Ask about your contacts, companies, and deals in plain English — "who's my warmest path to a CTO at Stripe?", "show me Series B deals by stage", "what needs my attention today?". You can also update your CRM — add tags, log notes, and move deal stages — with a preview-and-confirm step on every change and one-tap undo. Data is served from and stays in the KSA region. Scoped per-teammate via OAuth to the data and permissions your seat already has. Designed for private-markets investors, M&A teams, and search funds.
payload.longDescription: 4Degrees将您的关系智能和交易线索带入ChatGPT，服务于我们沙特阿拉伯地区的团队。您可以用自然语言询问联系人、公司和交易——「我在Stripe的CTO最热的路径是谁？」、「展示各阶段的B轮融资交易」、「今天有什么需要关注的？」。您还可以更新CRM——添加标签、记录笔记、推进交易阶段——每次修改都有预览确认步骤，支持一键撤销。数据从并保留在KSA地区。通过OAuth为每个团队成员分配权限，仅访问其账号已有的数据和权限。专为私募市场投资者、并购团队和搜索基金设计。

payload.name: VybeOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VybeOS turns a single brief into complete, on-brand marketing campaigns. Create campaigns, generate platform-ready content for Meta, TikTok, YouTube and more, refine copy through edits, and pull real performance metrics from your connected ad and social accounts — all from the conversation.
payload.longDescription: VybeOS将单一简报转化为完整的品牌营销活动。创建营销活动，为Meta、TikTok、YouTube等平台生成符合规范的内容，通过编辑优化文案，并从已连接的广告和社交账户中获取实时性能数据——所有操作均可通过对话完成。

payload.name: Goodword
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Businesses run on relationships. Your next deal, hire, client, or introduction starts with someone already in your network.

Goodword brings together your LinkedIn network, email and calendar history, and the private context behind each relationship, so ChatGPT can help you find the right people, understand why they matter, and act at the right moment.

Search your direct and extended network, pull enriched profiles and relationship history, and find warm paths to people you want to reach. Turn meeting debriefs into notes, reminders, and follow-ups. Manage introductions and groups, and see who you should reconnect with next.

A CRM manages contacts. LinkedIn gives you connections. Goodword helps you use the relationships you’ve already built to find clients, make key hires, raise capital, and get the introductions that move your business forward.

Requires a Goodword account. Access is scoped to your network through OAuth.
payload.longDescription:
商业建立在关系之上。下一笔交易、下一位员工、客户或引荐，往往始于你现有人脉中的某个人。

Goodword 汇总你的 LinkedIn 人脉、邮件和日历记录，以及每段关系背后的私人背景，让 ChatGPT 帮你找到合适的人、理解他们的重要性，并在恰当时机采取行动。

搜索直接和扩展人脉，获取丰富的个人资料与关系历史，找到联系目标人物的暖介绍路径。把会议复盘变成笔记、提醒和跟进。管理引荐和群组，查看下一步该与谁重新联系。

CRM 管理联系人，LinkedIn 提供连接；Goodword 帮你利用已经建立的关系寻找客户、招募关键人才、筹集资金，并获得推动业务发展的引荐。

需要 Goodword 账户。通过 OAuth 将访问范围限定在你的人脉网络内。

payload.name: Book Report
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book Report imports and organizes your sales data from Kindle Direct Publishing, Draft2Digital, and many more leading book publishing platforms. With this app, you can give ChatGPT access to that sales data. It can summarize trends, compare time periods, identify top books and series, break down earnings by distributor or marketplace, answer follow-up questions, and much more. Instead of clicking around to find the data you need, you can get it simply by asking. Access is read-only: the app can retrieve reports and catalog context, but cannot modify Book Report data, accounts, or connected publishing accounts.
payload.longDescription: Book Report 从 Kindle Direct Publishing、Draft2Digital 以及众多其他领先的图书出版平台导入并整理您的销售数据。通过此应用，您可以赋予 ChatGPT 访问这些销售数据的权限。它能够总结趋势、比较时间段、识别畅销书籍和系列、按分销商或市场分解收益、回答后续问题等。无需反复点击查找所需数据，您只需提出问题即可获取信息。访问权限为只读模式：该应用可检索报告和目录上下文，但无法修改 Book Report 的数据、账户或连接的出版账户。

payload.name: Page Pulse
payload.description: 跟踪搜索引擎优化和页面变更
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page Pulse combines Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 data, and on-page change tracking for the user's own websites. Through ChatGPT, users can list their tracked projects, investigate traffic drops by comparing analytics periods, see exactly what changed on their pages (content, titles, meta descriptions, links) and when, analyze the search queries driving traffic, start tracking new sites or hand-picked page lists, and set up email or Slack alerts for meaningful page changes or traffic thresholds.
payload.longDescription: Page Pulse整合了用户自有网站的Google Search Console数据、Google Analytics 4数据以及页面变更追踪功能。通过ChatGPT，用户可列出已追踪项目、通过对比分析周期调查流量下降原因、精确查看页面内容/标题/元描述/链接等具体变更内容及时间、分析引流搜索关键词、新增网站或自选页面清单的追踪功能，并为关键页面变更或流量阈值设置邮件或Slack警报。

payload.name: Enterpret
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enterpret helps teams understand what customers are saying across support tickets, sales calls, app reviews, surveys, Slack, and more. Ask natural-language questions to find complaint trends, feature requests, segment-specific patterns, and direct customer quotes. Results are grounded in your customer context graph and include links back to source records so product, GTM, and leadership teams can act with context.
payload.longDescription: Enterpret 帮助团队了解客户在支持工单、销售电话、应用评价、调查、Slack 等渠道中的反馈。你可以用自然语言提问，查找投诉趋势、功能需求、特定客群模式和客户原话。结果以客户上下文图谱为依据，并附有指向源记录的链接，让产品、GTM 和管理团队能结合背景采取行动。

payload.name: Jobicy
payload.description: 寻找远程工作和职业机会
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and filter live remote job opportunities from the Jobicy database. Find jobs by title, company, location, category, employment type, salary range, and more. Results are updated in real time and can be used by ChatGPT, AI agents, and developer tools through the Jobicy MCP server.
payload.longDescription: 通过Jobicy数据库搜索和筛选实时远程工作机会。通过职位名称、公司、地点、类别、雇佣类型、薪资范围等进行搜索和筛选。结果实时更新，可被ChatGPT、AI代理和开发工具通过Jobicy MCP服务器调用。

payload.name: ZipRecruiter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find live jobs on ZipRecruiter without leaving ChatGPT. Search by job title, company, or location, then narrow results by salary, distance, remote or hybrid work, employment type, and date posted. After reviewing a listing, jump to ZipRecruiter to apply. Example: “@ziprecruiter find me customer service jobs in Los Angeles that pay at least $24 an hour"
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可查找 ZipRecruiter 上的实时职位。按职位名称、公司或地点搜索，再按薪资、距离、远程或混合办公、雇佣类型和发布日期缩小结果范围。查看职位信息后，可跳转到 ZipRecruiter 申请。示例：“@ziprecruiter 找洛杉矶的客服工作，时薪至少 $24”

payload.name: HookRadar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HookRadar helps users research competitor paid ads and organic creative trends, analyze hooks and CTAs, compare creative momentum, and prepare creative intelligence reports from HookRadar data.
payload.longDescription: HookRadar助力用户研究竞争对手的付费广告和自然创意趋势，分析钩子和行动呼吁，比较创意发展势头，并基于HookRadar数据生成创意情报报告。

payload.name: Controlle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
O Controlle é uma plataforma de gestão financeira para pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras, com foco no setor de serviços.

Com este plugin, você acessa o financeiro da sua empresa direto na conversa. Consulte saldo por conta, contas a pagar e a receber por período, lançamentos por categoria e a projeção de fluxo de caixa. Também é possível registrar novos lançamentos e atualizar informações, sempre com confirmação antes de gravar.

Exemplos de uso: "quanto tenho a pagar essa semana?", "como ficou meu fluxo de caixa em julho?", "quais clientes estão em atraso?", "lance uma despesa de energia de R$ 1.200 com vencimento dia 15".

É necessário ter uma conta ativa no Controlle. No primeiro uso, você conecta sua conta e autoriza o acesso.
payload.longDescription:
Controlle 是面向巴西中小企业、重点服务行业的财务管理平台。

通过插件可在对话中查询账户余额、按期间查看应付和应收账款、按类别查看记录以及现金流预测，也可登记和更新记录，写入前始终需要确认。

示例：“我这周要付多少钱？”、“7 月现金流怎么样？”、“哪些客户逾期？”、“登记一笔 R$ 1.200 的电费，15 日到期。”

需要有效的 Controlle 账户。首次使用时需连接账户并授权访问。

payload.name: Magister Marketing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magister Marketing connects your brand's marketing workspace to ChatGPT. Review your brand profile and marketing plan, then work the plan item by item: read the next prioritized task with its full brief, record progress notes, and update item status as work ships.

Track AI visibility and GEO. See how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews answer the prompts your buyers actually ask about your category, start new scoring rounds, and open an interactive report showing score trends across rounds, results by AI model, and per-prompt detail.

Run SEO and answer-engine audits with per-channel health scores, research keywords with search volume and difficulty, and review Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads performance. Draft and schedule social posts from your brand voice, pull per-post and follower analytics, discover influencers by channel and topic, work with project assets and files, monitor public sources for brand mentions, and open pull requests against a connected GitHub repository.

Writes are scoped and audited. Publishing a post, sending an email, merging a pull request, and deleting a file each stop at an explicit confirmation or a server-side approval that a person must grant in the Magister app before anything happens. New ad campaigns are created paused on Meta or TikTok, and this connector has no way to activate a campaign or begin ad spend. Requires a Magister account.
payload.longDescription:
Magister Marketing 将品牌营销工作区连接到 ChatGPT。查看品牌资料和营销计划，然后逐项执行计划：读取下一项优先任务及完整简报，记录进展笔记，并在工作完成时更新项目状态。

追踪 AI 可见度和 GEO。查看 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 如何回答买家对你所在品类实际提出的问题，开始新一轮评分，并打开交互式报告，查看各轮评分趋势、各 AI 模型结果和每个提示词的详情。

运行 SEO 和答案引擎审计，查看各渠道健康评分；研究带搜索量和难度的关键词；审查 Google Ads、Meta Ads 和 TikTok Ads 表现。以品牌声音起草并安排社交帖子，获取每条帖子和粉丝分析，按渠道和主题发现影响者，使用项目资产和文件，监测公开来源中的品牌提及，并针对已连接的 GitHub 仓库创建拉取请求。

所有写入操作都受范围限制并经过审计。发布帖子、发送邮件、合并拉取请求和删除文件，都会在实际发生前停留在明确确认步骤，或等待人工在 Magister 应用中授予服务器端批准。Meta 或 TikTok 上创建的新广告活动会以暂停状态创建，此连接器无法启用活动或开始广告支出。需要 Magister 账户。

payload.name: PredictLeads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Give your AI assistant structured intelligence on millions of companies worldwide. Data sourced directly from company websites, career pages, news outlets, SEC filings, and review sites. Continuously refreshed, with 5+ years of history.

Every API endpoint is a native tool: ask natural-language questions, get structured answers.

- Enrich known companies by domain name: news, job postings, technographics, key customers, lookalikes.
- Discover net new companies by criteria: technologies used, hiring activity, funding received and more. Filtered by location, size, and industry.

Signal types: News Events (launches, partnerships, leadership changes...), Job Openings (with salaries, seniority, locations), Technology Detections, Financing Events, Similar Companies, SEC Filings (as Markdown), Product offerings, Key Customers, and GitHub Activity.
