payload.name: Motion
payload.description: 分析 Meta 创意广告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Motion connects OpenAI to your creative analytics workspace. Analyze ad creative performance across Meta campaigns — surface top performers, spot declining creatives, and understand what's working and why. Research competitor ad libraries for trends and inspiration. Access demographic breakdowns, creative transcripts, and performance reports. Motion helps marketers make faster, data-driven decisions about what to create next.
payload.longDescription: Motion 将 OpenAI 连接到你的创意分析工作区。分析 Meta 广告系列中的广告创意表现，找出高绩效创意、发现表现下滑的创意，并了解哪些内容有效以及原因。研究竞争对手广告库以获取趋势和灵感。访问人口统计细分、创意转录和绩效报告。Motion 帮助营销人员更快地以数据为依据决定下一步创作。

payload.name: Litera
payload.description: Litera的Lito插件将事务所的集体知识和经验带入ChatGPT。用自然语言提问并获取引用答案，无需离开对话界面。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Litera's Lito plugin brings your firm's collective knowledge and experience into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get cited answers drawn from your firm's experience data, without leaving the conversation.

- Natural language search: ask questions like "Show me M&A deals for banking clients in Japan" and get results with entity links across matters, clients, people and experience records.
- Tabular results: view paged, sortable tables from any search to quickly scan and compare results.
- Matter profiles: pull up full matter details by drilling into a specific matter from your search results.
- Client profiles: retrieve complete client profiles to understand relationship history and related experience.
- People profiles: look up individuals to find their expertise, matter history and firm roles.
- Marketing packet profiles: access full experience packets to support pitches, proposals and RFPs.
- Conversational refinement: chain any of the above together with follow-up questions to narrow down exactly what you need.

All answers include citations and respect firm security permissions, ethical walls, and user entitlements, so professionals only see what they are authorised to access. Litera’s Lito helps lawyers and business professionals tap into firm knowledge with deterministic accuracy, Raising The Bar™ on a process that would otherwise require navigating multiple systems or relying on institutional memory.
payload.longDescription:
Litera的Lito插件将事务所的集体知识和经验带入ChatGPT。用自然语言提问并获取引用答案，无需离开对话界面。

- 自然语言搜索：以「显示日本银行客户并购交易」等自然语言提问，获取包含跨案件、客户、人员和经验记录的实体链接结果。
- 表格结果：从任何搜索中查看分页可排序表格，快速浏览和比较结果。
- 案件档案：通过搜索结果中特定案件深入查看完整案件详情。
- 客户档案：调取完整客户档案，了解关系历史和相关经验。
- 人员档案：查询个人资料，查找专业领域、案件历史和事务所角色。
- 市场推广包档案：访问完整经验包以支持路演、提案和RFP。
- 对话式精炼：通过后续问题将上述功能串联，精准定位所需信息。

所有答案均包含引用内容，并遵循事务所安全权限、道德防火墙和用户授权，确保专业人士仅能看到其权限范围内的信息。Litera的Lito帮助律师和商业专业人士以确定性精准度获取事务所知识，通过Raising The Bar™提升原本需要穿梭多个系统或依赖机构记忆的流程。

payload.name: SmartFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SmartFlow Portal brings client projects into ChatGPT. View project plans and milestones, follow actions waiting on you, review invoices, and keep delivery moving. Authorized SmartFlow administrators can also manage organizations, plans, client submissions, time entries, and billing workflows, with access enforced from the signed-in user's role and organization scope.
payload.longDescription: SmartFlow门户将客户项目带入ChatGPT。查看项目计划和关键节点，跟踪等待您的操作，审核发票并推动交付进程。授权的SmartFlow管理员还可管理组织架构、计划方案、客户提交内容、工时记录和计费工作流程，访问权限由已登录用户的角色和组织范围强制执行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read project boards and plans, Track and submit client tasks, Manage clients and their teams, Build projects, stages and tasks, Upload documents, request signatures, Draft, publish and send invoices, Download invoice PDFs and document files, Set up recurring billing, Schedule meetings, Read and send messages, Search conversations and discuss board items, Publish announcements, Handle client requests, Log time, Review workspace settings and integrations, Triage leads and outbound prospects, Watch client activity

payload.name: Recruiterflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recruiterflow helps users search and count candidates and jobs, resolve team members, companies, stages, and custom fields, inspect job pipelines, and review candidate activity timelines through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Recruiterflow 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索并统计候选人和职位、确定团队成员、公司、阶段和自定义字段、查看职位招聘流程，并检查候选人活动时间线。

payload.name: POCKET CFO
payload.description: 经营咨询与业务全方位支持服务
payload.summaryOriginal: 経営相談ビジネスのトータルサポートサービス
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ご自分のビジネスそのまま相談できます。

「使える補助金ある？」　「今月の利益は？」　「財務状況は？」　「融資を受けたい」　など
——ポケットCFOに登録された実際の取引から集計して答えます。

業種・地域・規模から絞り込んだ補助金や融資の候補も確認できます。

数字には必ず出どころ（対象期間・件数・数え方）が付きます。推測した数字は返しません。
まだ扱っていないもの（現預金の残高など）は、扱っていないとお伝えします。

読み取り専用です。請求書の発行・支払い・データの書き換えはできません。
許可はいつでも取り消せます。
payload.longDescription:
您可以直接咨询自己的业务。

例如：“有什么可申请的补助金吗？”“本月利润是多少？”“财务状况如何？”“我想申请贷款。”系统会根据登记在 Pocket CFO 中的真实交易汇总并作答。

您还可以根据行业、地区和规模筛选补助金及贷款候选项目。

每个数字都会标明其来源（统计期间、笔数和计算方法）。不会返回推测得出的数字。
尚未支持的内容（例如现金和存款余额）会明确告知您暂不支持。

此工具为只读。无法开具发票、付款或改写数据。
您可以随时撤销授权。

payload.name: Guest-Ready Score
payload.description: 评估您的房源准备情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guest-Ready Score is a 12-question assessment that measures how ready a short-term rental is to welcome guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, and owners of cottages, cabins, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny homes, furnished rentals and holiday rentals.

The assessment reviews twelve core areas of the guest stay: arrival and check-in, beds and sleeping comfort, bathrooms, kitchen readiness, lighting, temperature and climate comfort, Wi-Fi, cleanliness, restocking, guest communication, safety, and local information. It takes about two minutes and provides a Guest-Ready Score showing the areas already working well and the areas where attention will most improve the stay.

Use Guest-Ready Score to check whether a property is ready to list, prepare for a first guest, audit an existing rental, benchmark against hospitality standards, or find the areas most likely to lift guest reviews.

The standards come from The Guest Before The Rest by Valerie Balderson and Greg Hoover, drawn from seventeen years of furnished rental management in Ottawa, Canada.
payload.longDescription:
Guest-Ready Score是一项包含12个问题的评估测试，用于衡量短期租赁房源迎接客人的准备程度。该评估针对Airbnb房东、短期租赁业主、度假租赁运营商，以及木屋、小屋、湖畔房屋、海滩别墅、雪茄屋、公寓、客房、旅馆、别墅、滑雪房产、临水租赁房产、乡村住宅、微型住宅、带家具租赁房产和节日租赁房产的所有者。

该评估涵盖客人入住的十二个核心领域：到达与入住、床铺与睡眠舒适度、卫生间、厨房准备情况、照明、温度与气候舒适度、Wi-Fi、清洁度、补货情况、客人沟通、安全措施和本地信息。评估耗时约两分钟，会生成一个Guest-Ready评分，显示当前表现良好的方面以及最需要关注的改进领域。

使用Guest-Ready Score可检查房源是否已准备好上架、为首位客人做准备、审计现有租赁房产、与酒店业标准进行基准比较，或找出最可能提升客人评价的改进领域。

这些评估标准源自Valerie Balderson和Greg Hoover所著《客人永远先于一切》，其内容源于作者在加拿大渥太华长达十七年的家具齐全租赁管理经验。

payload.name: Tracxn MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tracxn MCP gives you access to the full Tracxn platform - companies, funding rounds, investors, M&A, cap tables, financials, and more - directly from your favorite AI assistant.

What you can do once connected:
- Search for companies by sector, geography, stage, or custom criteria
- Pull funding histories and investor profiles
- Track recent M&A, IPOs, and market activity
- Generate research reports grounded in real Tracxn data
payload.longDescription:
Tracxn MCP让您能够通过最喜爱的AI助手直接访问完整的Tracxn平台——包括公司信息、融资轮次、投资者、并购交易、资本结构表、财务数据等更多内容。

连接后可实现以下操作：
- 按行业、地区、发展阶段或自定义条件搜索公司
- 提取融资历史及投资者档案
- 跟踪最新并购交易、IPO及市场动态
- 基于真实Tracxn数据生成研究报告

payload.name: Clera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clera helps company hiring teams search vetted candidates against a role, review recommendations, request introductions, track hiring progress, and manage roles, public company profiles and private contacts. Search results mask candidate names but retain professional history; semantic search may send search inputs to Azure. Role-based searches show advisory fit flags that do not block introductions. Detailed profiles can remain available after an earlier named share expires or is revoked, and professional free text may contain personal details. Introduction requests can send emails and submit applications to a connected hiring system. Feedback is sent through Slack with user and company identity. Private call logs retain caller identity, inputs and results without automatic expiry.
payload.longDescription: Clera帮助公司招聘团队根据职位搜索经过筛选的候选人，查看推荐意见，请求介绍，跟踪招聘进度，并管理职位信息、公开公司资料及私人联系人。搜索结果会隐藏候选人姓名，但保留其专业经历；语义搜索可能将搜索内容发送至Azure。基于职位的搜索会显示咨询适配标志，但不会阻止介绍请求。详细资料在早期指定的分享过期或被撤销后仍可访问，专业领域的自由文本可能包含个人详情。介绍请求可发送邮件并提交申请至连接的招聘系统。反馈通过Slack发送，包含用户及公司身份信息。私人通话记录会保留通话者身份、输入内容及结果，且不会自动过期。

payload.name: AdsAgent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdsAgent helps advertising operators inspect Meta performance, manage reusable launch templates, prepare campaign changes, and execute explicitly confirmed Meta advertising actions through ChatGPT. OAuth connects to the operator's own AdsAgent workspace; advertising delivery changes require explicit confirmation, and workspace templates and settings can be edited directly at the user's request. AdsAgent never asks for health, payment-card, government-ID, or biometric data.
payload.longDescription: AdsAgent帮助广告运营人员检查Meta表现，管理可重复使用的启动模板，准备活动变更，并通过ChatGPT执行明确确认的Meta广告操作。OAuth连接至运营商自有的AdsAgent工作区；广告投放变更需要明确确认，工作区模板和设置可根据用户请求直接编辑。AdsAgent不会索取健康信息、支付卡、政府身份证或生物识别数据。

payload.name: Atlas
payload.description: 在聊天中发送和签署合同
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Atlas is your AI contract agent. Unlimited e-sign is free, with no credit card required.

Draft an agreement in the conversation, or share a PDF or DOCX, and Atlas turns it into a signable document: it detects signature lines, dates, and fields, and works out who signs what. You get a review link, click Send, and signers get a clean signing page on any device with no account needed.

Ask things like "send this MSA to sarah@acme.com for signature," "who still hasn't signed?", "remind them," or "pull the payment terms from the signed contract." Repeat sends run from saved templates in one message.

Atlas is review-first: it prepares everything and a human approves before any signature request goes out. Every signed document includes a completion certificate and a full audit trail.
payload.longDescription:
Atlas是您的AI合同代理。无限次电子签名免费，无需信用卡

在对话中起草协议，或分享PDF或DOCX文件，Atlas会将其转换为可签署的文档：它会检测签名行、日期和字段，并确定各方的签署内容。您将获得预览链接，点击发送后，签署人即可在任何设备上通过无需账户的简洁签署页面完成操作

可发送类似「将这份MSA发送至sarah@acme.com进行签署」、「还有谁未签署？」、「提醒他们」或「从已签署合同中提取付款条款」的指令。重复发送可通过一个消息中的已保存模板完成

Atlas采用审核优先策略：它会预先准备好所有内容，并在任何签名请求发出前由人工审核。每份已签署的文件均包含完成证书和完整的审计追踪记录

payload.name: Flexport
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flexport helps users search logistics reference data, track and browse shipments, review quote requests and pricing, request rates, and create freight bookings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Flexport帮助用户搜索物流参考数据，跟踪和浏览货运信息，审核报价请求和定价，请求报价，并通过ChatGPT创建货运预订。

payload.name: AlterVision
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AlterVision helps retail teams analyze visitor traffic, sales, conversion rates, and progress toward store and seller targets. Connect an existing account to find stores, compare daily performance, review sales competition standings, and investigate why visits did not become purchases through reason summaries and seller-recorded explanations. Non-conversion reports and sales competitions require AlterVez access.
payload.longDescription:
AlterVision帮助零售团队分析访客流量、销售数据、转化率以及达成店铺和卖家目标的进度。
连接现有账户可查找店铺，对比每日表现，查看销售竞争排名，并通过原因总结和卖家记录的解释，分析访问量未转化为购买的原因。
非转化报告和销售竞争数据需要AlterVez访问权限。

payload.name: Tassyir
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tassyir is the back office of e-commerce merchants in Algeria. Once a merchant connects their Tassyir business, ChatGPT can review sales (orders, confirmation and delivery rates, delivered revenue, ad spend, best sellers and top wilayas), work the order queue (list pending orders, confirm, cancel, schedule, assign and comment on them, dispatch confirmed orders to delivery and follow parcels until delivered or returned), manage the catalog (create and update products with sizes, colors and per-variant prices, categories and stock levels) and keep the books (record expenses and capital transactions). Every action runs with the merchant’s own Tassyir role permissions, on the one business they connected. Amounts are in Algerian dinars (DZD).
payload.longDescription: Tassyir是阿尔及利亚电商商家的后台系统。商家连接其Tassyir账户后，ChatGPT可查看销售数据（订单、确认率与交付率、已交付营收、广告支出、畅销品和热门省区）、处理订单队列（列出待处理订单、进行确认/取消/调度/分配并添加备注、将确认订单分配给物流并追踪包裹直至交付或退回）、管理商品目录（创建和编辑商品，设置尺寸/颜色及各变体价格、分类和库存水平）以及财务记账（记录费用和资本交易）。所有操作均基于商家自身的Tassyir角色权限，在其已连接的单一业务账户下执行。金额单位为阿尔及利亚第纳尔（DZD）。

payload.name: Hyros
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hyros tracks every ad click, lead, and sale, so you can see which campaigns, ads, and keywords actually produce revenue. This app brings that data into ChatGPT.

Ask in plain language and get answers from your live Hyros account:

• "Which Meta campaigns had the best ROAS last month?"
• "What were my best performing ads last month?"
• "Where did last week's revenue actually come from?"
• "Show me an overview of the last 7 days"

ChatGPT can pull attribution reports, spend and ROAS by campaign or ad set, lead and customer journeys, revenue and LTV breakdowns, and call and booking data, then chart it, summarize it or drop it into the doc you're already writing.

Built for media buyers, agencies, and growth teams who spend their days reconciling ad platform numbers against what actually hit the bank account.

Requires an active Hyros account. You connect with your Hyros login, and ChatGPT only sees data that account already has access to.
payload.longDescription:
Hyros会追踪每个广告点击、潜在客户和销售情况，让您清楚了解哪些广告系列、广告和关键词真正带来了收入。该应用将这些数据带入ChatGPT。

用自然语言提问，即可从您的实时Hyros账户获取答案：

• 「上个月哪些Meta广告系列的广告支出回报率最高？」
• 「上个月哪些广告表现最佳？」
• 「上周的收入实际来自哪里？」
• 「给我一个过去7天的概览」

ChatGPT可以提取归因报告、按广告系列或广告组划分的花费和广告支出回报率、潜在客户和客户旅程数据、收入和客户终身价值分解，以及通话和预约数据，然后进行图表展示、内容总结或直接插入您正在编写的文档中。

专为广告采购人员、代理机构和增长团队设计，帮助他们每天核对广告平台数据与实际到账金额。

需要有效的Hyros账户。
您可通过Hyros账号登录，ChatGPT仅能查看该账户已有访问权限的数据。

payload.name: Salesloft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Salesloft helps users find and inspect accounts, people, opportunities, users, and recorded conversations from their Salesloft workspace directly in ChatGPT. It supports looking up who is logged in and their team settings, searching or fetching a single account, user, opportunity, or contact by ID, and searching recorded calls and meetings to pull AI-generated summaries or a recording link. Users can also send feedback about the assistant's responses or tools back to Salesloft.
payload.longDescription: Salesloft可让用户直接在ChatGPT中查找并查看其Salesloft工作区中的账户、人员、销售机会、用户以及记录的对话。该工具支持查看当前登录人员及其团队设置，通过ID搜索或获取单个账户、用户、销售机会或联系人信息，并可搜索已记录的电话和会议以获取AI生成的摘要或录音链接。用户还可向Salesloft反馈助手回答或工具使用体验。

payload.name: iLands.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: חפשו והשוו פרויקטים להשקעה בקרקעות לפי אזור, תקציב, סטטוס תכנוני, רמת סיכון ואופק השקעה. קבלו פרטי פרויקט, הסברים למונחים מרכזיים ואפשרויות שמתאימות להעדפות שלכם.
payload.longDescription: 根据区域、预算、规划状态、风险等级和投资期限搜索和比较土地投资项目。获取项目详情、关键术语解释以及符合您偏好的选项。

payload.name: eCore Enrichment Email Phone
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search a database of 24M+ verified B2B contacts and companies by industry, job title, seniority level, location, employee count, and revenue. Reveal verified email addresses and direct or mobile phone numbers for selected contacts. Enrich a single contact from a LinkedIn URL, an email, or a name plus company. Submit lists of email addresses for deliverability validation and check job progress. Each action uses credits from your eCore wallet; the cost is shown before the call and your balance can be checked any time.
payload.longDescription: 通过行业、职位名称、职级、地点、员工数量和营收等条件，在包含2400万+个经过验证的B2B联系人及企业的数据库中进行搜索。揭示选定联系人的经验证电子邮件地址及直接联系方式或手机号码。通过LinkedIn链接、电子邮件或姓名加公司信息来完善单个联系人资料。提交电子邮件地址列表进行送达率验证并查看任务进度。每次操作都会消耗您的eCore钱包中的积分；在操作前会显示费用，您可随时查看余额。

payload.name: Didit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect to your Didit workspace using your existing account, organization roles and permissions.

Create hosted verification links, find verification sessions and review their status, inspect and edit workflows and questionnaires, check case and report status, manage webhook destinations, and review aggregate verification analytics.

Customers complete identity checks on Didit's hosted verification page. Session and case results in ChatGPT contain operational references, statuses, dates and counts. Detailed identity evidence, images, private notes and report contents stay outside this plugin's responses.

The plugin does not offer standalone document or face uploads, government ID number inputs, one-time verification code inputs, raw API keys or payment checkout. Requested workspace information is shared with ChatGPT to answer your request. Only request records you are authorized to access and share. Review proposed changes before approving actions. An existing Didit account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过现有账户连接到您的Didit工作区，使用组织角色和权限进行访问。

创建托管验证链接，查找验证会话并查看其状态，检查和编辑工作流程及问卷调查，查看案件和报告状态，管理Webhook目标地址，并查看汇总验证分析数据。

客户在Didit的托管验证页面完成身份核验。ChatGPT中的会话和案件结果包含操作参考信息、状态、日期及统计数量。详细身份证据、图片、私有备注及报告内容不会包含在本插件的响应中。

该插件不提供独立文档或人脸上传、政府身份证号输入、一次性验证码输入、原始API密钥或支付结账功能。为解答您的请求，会共享所需的工作区信息至ChatGPT。仅可请求您有权访问和分享的记录，审批操作前请审阅拟议的更改。需要已有的Didit账户。

payload.name: AutoQuote3D
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AutoQuote3D helps 3D-printing businesses manage quotes, orders, customers, catalog pricing, and storefront operations through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: AutoQuote3D通过ChatGPT帮助3D打印企业处理报价、订单、客户管理、产品目录定价及店铺运营。

payload.name: Zernio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Zernio connects ChatGPT to the social media accounts you have already linked in your Zernio workspace: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Snapchat, Discord and Slack.

Ask ChatGPT to schedule a post for a specific time, publish immediately, edit or cancel something that has not gone out yet, retry a failed post, or check a draft against each platform's rules (character limits, required media or title) before it is scheduled. Review what is scheduled, drafted, published or failed, and pull performance numbers: impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves and views for one post or across your accounts, plus the best times to post based on your own history.

Every action is limited to your own Zernio account. Publishing tools always ask for the exact accounts to use, and anything that goes live immediately is confirmed with you first. Sign in with your existing Zernio account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Zernio将ChatGPT与您在Zernio工作区中已链接的社交媒体账户连接：Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X、LinkedIn、Facebook、Threads、Pinterest、Reddit、Bluesky、Google商业资料、Telegram、Snapchat、Discord和Slack。

让ChatGPT为特定时间安排帖子，立即发布，编辑或取消尚未发出的内容，重试失败的帖子，或在发布前根据各平台规则（字符限制、必要媒体或标题）检查草稿。
查看已安排、草稿、已发布或失败的内容，获取性能数据：单个帖子或跨账户的曝光量、触达量、点赞、评论、分享、保存和观看次数，以及基于您历史记录的最佳发布时间。

所有操作均限于您的Zernio账户。
发布工具会始终要求指定具体的账户，任何立即上线的内容都会先征得您的确认。
使用现有Zernio账户登录即可开始。

payload.name: Jusratio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jusratio connects ChatGPT to Brazilian case law and legislation. Search 42+ million deduplicated decisions from 99 Brazilian courts and public authorities, alongside consolidated legislation structured article by article. Results are ranked by legal authority and linked to their original sources.

Use Jusratio to find relevant and binding precedents, validate legal arguments, identify contrary authorities, compare court positions, review legal documents, and draft well-grounded legal analyses, opinions, briefs, and other legal work with verifiable citations.

Create a free Jusratio account, no credit card required, to get started. Usage limits and available features depend on your plan.

payload.name: Trainual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trainual is where growing companies run the operating side of the business — how work should be done, and how it is actually going.

This plugin provides read access to your Trainual account so answers are grounded in your company’s own documented practice and current operating context rather than generic advice.

From the Training suite: search documented processes, policies, and role expectations. See what training has been assigned and who has completed it. Look up what a role is responsible for and which tools a team uses.

From the Operations suite: pull goals and progress against them, scorecard metrics and trends, meeting records and action items, and recurring team updates.

Together that means you can ask how something is supposed to work and how it is actually going in the same conversation — the connection Trainual is built around.

Common uses include onboarding support, answering "how do we do this here" without interrupting a colleague, preparing for a meeting or a one-on-one, checking training completion across a team, and drafting content that stays consistent with documented process.

Access follows Trainual’s existing permission model. Users only reach content their Trainual account already permits, and the plugin never modifies data.
payload.longDescription:
Trainual是成长型公司管理业务运营的场所——工作应如何开展以及实际推进情况如何。

该插件提供对Trainual账户的只读访问权限，确保回答基于您公司内部的文档化实践和当前运营背景，而非通用建议。

在培训模块中：搜索已记录的流程、政策和岗位期望。
查看已分配的培训内容及完成人员名单。
查阅岗位职责及团队使用的工具列表。

在运营模块中：查看目标及完成进度、评分卡指标与趋势、会议记录与行动项、以及定期团队更新内容。

这意味着您可以在同一场对话中同时询问『应该怎样运作』和『实际进展如何』——这正是Trainual的核心所在。

常见使用场景包括：提供入职支持、在不打扰同事的情况下解答『我们在这里是如何操作的』、为会议或一对一沟通做准备、检查团队培训完成情况，以及撰写与文档化流程保持一致的内容。

访问权限遵循Trainual现有的权限模型。
用户仅能查看其Trainual账户已授权的内容，插件从不修改任何数据。

payload.name: AfterShip Post-Purchase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AfterShip Post-Purchase for ChatGPT makes shipment and returns operations as easy as having a conversation. Connect your AfterShip data and simply chat to search shipments, review delivery status and tracking timelines, spot exceptions, look up specific orders, or review return and RMA details including refund progress, shipping status, returned items, and outcomes. Then act on what you find: with your confirmation, ChatGPT can correct shipment records, re-track stalled shipment, mark a final delivery status, and move returns through approval, receiving, and resolution — always scoped to your organization and your own AfterShip role.

payload.name: HYPD.AI for Search Console
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HYPD.AI Google Search Console brings data from authorized Search Console properties into ChatGPT, helping site owners, marketers, and SEO teams understand how their sites appear in Google Search.

Use it to:

• Diagnose why a site or URL is not showing on Google by reviewing index status, crawl and fetch state, robots access, sitemaps, canonicals, and mobile usability.

• Explain indexing issues such as Crawled – currently not indexed, Discovered – currently not indexed, duplicate canonicals, noindex, blocked pages, soft 404s, redirects, and server errors.

• Check sitemap processing, errors, warnings, download dates, and URL counts.

• Analyze keywords and rankings using clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, date, or search appearance.

• Compare periods to find traffic gains and losses, CTR opportunities, ranking changes, and the queries driving each page.

• List connected properties and explore Search Console data conversationally through ChatGPT and MCP.

HYPD.AI is read-only. It cannot request indexing, submit sitemaps, add or verify properties, manage users, edit content, or change rankings. It analyzes connected properties, explains findings, and recommends next steps.
payload.longDescription:
HYPD.AI Google搜索控制台将已授权的搜索控制台数据导入ChatGPT，帮助网站所有者、营销人员和SEO团队了解其网站在Google搜索中的展示情况。

可用于：

• 通过检查索引状态、抓取和获取状态、机器人访问权限、站点地图、规范标签及移动可用性，诊断网站或URL未在Google展示的原因。

• 解释索引问题，例如「已抓取-当前未索引」、「已发现-当前未索引」、重复规范标签、noindex标记、被阻止页面、软404错误、重定向和服务器错误。

• 检查站点地图处理情况、错误警告、下载日期及URL数量。

• 通过查询、页面、国家、设备、日期或搜索展示位置，分析关键词和排名数据（包括点击量、展示量、点击率和平均排名）。

• 对比不同周期数据，发现流量增减情况、点击率优化机会、排名变化及驱动各页面流量的搜索关键词。

• 列出已连接的站点，并通过与ChatGPT和MCP的对话方式探索Search Console数据。

HYPD.AI 为只读模式，无法请求索引、提交站点地图、添加或验证站点、管理用户、编辑内容或更改排名。它会分析已连接的站点，解释分析结果并推荐下一步操作。
